entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: A village in the hinterlands of Kjeldor, Terisiare, during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Grew up in Mikkel before becoming the Elder Druid.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer whose legions took the village.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Traitor commanding Lim-Dûl's legions at Mikkel.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Survivor whose magic helped lay the dead to rest.

events.summary: In 2934 AR Mikkel fell to Lim-Dûl's legions under the traitor Avram Garrisson.
events.quote: the village fell to Lim-Dûl 's legions under the charge of the traitor Avram Garrisson

events.summary: The six survivors buried the dead and abandoned the village, heading south toward Fyndhorn.
events.quote: the six survivors abandoned the village and headed south toward Fyndhorn
